starting-out-talking-to-chancellor-hassa.speaker: Hassan
starting-out-talking-to-chancellor-hassa.text: Greetings I am Hassan, Chancellor to the Emir of Al- Kharid.

options.text: Can I help you? You must need some help here in the desert.

steps.speaker: Hassan
steps.text: I need the services of someone, yes. If you are interested, see the spymaster, Osman. I manage the finances here. Come to me when you need payment.

options.text: It's just too hot here. How can you stand it?
Do you mind if I just kill your warriors?

starting-out-talking-to-chancellor-hassa.speaker: Hassan
starting-out-talking-to-chancellor-hassa.text: Have you found the spymaster, Osman, yet? You cannot proceed in your task without reporting to him.

starting-out-talking-to-chancellor-hassa.speaker: Hassan
starting-out-talking-to-chancellor-hassa.text: I understand the Spymaster has hired you. I will pay the reward only when the Prince is rescued.

starting-out-talking-to-osman.player: The chancellor trusts me. I have come for instructions.

starting-out-talking-to-osman.speaker: Osman
starting-out-talking-to-osman.text: Our prince is captive by the Lady Keli. We just need to make the rescue. There are two things we need you to do.

options.text: What is the first thing I must do?

steps.player: What is the first thing I must do?

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: The prince is guarded by some stupid guards and a clever woman. The woman is our only way to get the prince out. Only she can walk freely about the area.

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: I think you will need to tie her up. One coil of rope should do for that. Then, disguise the prince as her to get him out without suspicion.

steps.player: How good must the disguise be?

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: Only enough to fool the guards at a distance. Get a skirt like hers. Same colour, same style. We will only have a short time.

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: Get a blonde wig, too. That is up to you to make or find. Something to colour the skin of the prince.

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: My daughter and top spy, Leela, can help you. She has sent word that she has discovered where they are keeping the prince.

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: It's near Draynor Village. She is lurking somewhere near there now.

options.text: Explain the first thing again.
What is the second thing you need?
Okay, I better go find some things.
What is the second thing you need?

steps.player: What is the second thing you need?

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: We need the key, or we need a copy made. If you can get some soft clay then you can copy the key...

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: ...If you can convince Lady Keli to show it to you for a moment. She is very boastful. It should not be too hard.

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: Bring the imprint to me, with a bar of bronze.

options.text: What is the first thing I must do?
What exactly is the second thing you need?
Okay, I better go find some things.
Okay, I better go find some things.

steps.player: Okay, I had better go find some things.

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: May good luck travel with you. Don't forget to find Leela. It can't be done without her help.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.player: Can you tell me what I still need to get?

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player has not obtained the key print:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: A print of the key in soft clay and a bronze bar. Then, collect the key from Leela.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player has given Osman the key print and not picked up the bronze key:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: You can collect the key from Leela.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player has obtained the bronze key from Leela:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: The key you already have. Good.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player has not obtained the blonde wig:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: You need to make a blonde wig somehow. Leela may help.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player has obtained the blonde wig:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: The wig you have got; well done.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player does not have a pink skirt in your inventory:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: You will need a skirt that looks the same as Keli's.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player have a pink skirt in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: You have the skirt. Good.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player does not have the skin paste in your inventory:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: Something to make the prince's skin appear lighter.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player has a skin paste in your inventory:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: You have the skin paint; well done. I thought you would struggle to make that.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player has a rope in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: Yes, you have the rope.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: If the player does not have a rope in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: A rope with which to tie Keli up.

starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.speaker: Osman
starting-out-talking-to-osman-talking-to.text: Once you have everything, go to Leela. She must be ready to get the prince away.

starting-out-talking-to-leela.player: I am here to help you free the prince.

starting-out-talking-to-leela.speaker: Leela
starting-out-talking-to-leela.text: Your employment is known to me. Now, do you know all that we need to make the break?

options.text: I must make a disguise. What do you suggest?

steps.player: I must make a disguise. What do you suggest?

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Only the lady Keli, can wander about outside the jail. The guards will shoot to kill if they see the prince out so we need a disguise good enough to fool them at a distance.
If the player does not have a blonde wig:

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: You need a wig, maybe made from wool. If you find someone who can work with wool ask them about it. There's a witch nearby may be able to help you dye it.
If the player has a blonde wig:

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: The wig you have got, well done.
If the player does not have a pink skirt:

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: You will need to get a pink skirt, same as Keli's.
If the player has a pink skirt:

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: You have got the skirt, good.
If the player does not have the skin paste:

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: We still need something to colour the Prince's skin lighter. There's a witch close to here. She knows about many things. She may know some way to make the skin lighter.
If the player has the skin paste:

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: You have the skin paint, well done. I thought you would struggle to make that.
If the player does not have a rope:

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: You will still need some rope to tie up Keli, of course. I heard that there's a good rope maker around here.
If the player has a rope:

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: You have rope I see, to tie up Keli. That will be the most dangerous part of the plan.

options.text: I need to get the key made.

steps.player: I need to get the key made.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Yes, that is most important. There is no way you can get the real key. It is on a chain around Keli's neck. Almost impossible to steal.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Get some soft clay and get her to show you the key somehow. Then take the print, with bronze, to my father.

options.text: What can I do with the guards?

steps.player: What can I do with the guards?

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Most of the guards will be easy. The disguise will get past them. The only guard who will be a problem will be the one at the door.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: We can discuss this more when you have the rest of the escape kit.

options.text: I will go and get the rest of the escape equipment.

steps.player: I will go and get the rest of the escape equipment.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Good, I shall await your return with everything.

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-ned.speaker: Ned
preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-ned.text: Why, hello there, [lad/lass]. Me friends call me Ned. I was a man of the sea, but it's past me now. Could I be making or selling you some rope?

options.text: Could you make other things apart from rope?

steps.player: Could you make other things apart from rope?

steps.speaker: Ned
steps.text: I'm sure I can. What are you thinking of?

options.text: Could you knit me a sweater?

steps.player: Could you knit me a sweater?

steps.speaker: Ned
steps.text: Do I look like a member of a sewing circle? Be off wi' you. I have fought monsters that would turn your hair blue.

steps.speaker: Ned
steps.text: I don't need to be laughed at just 'cos I'm getting a bit old.

options.text: How about some sort of wig?

steps.player: How about some sort of wig?

steps.speaker: Ned
steps.text: Well... That's an interesting thought. Yes, I think I could do something. Give me 3 balls of wool and I might be able to do it.
If the player does not have three balls of wool:

steps.player: Great, I will get some. I think a wig would be useful.

steps.text: If the player has three balls of wool:

options.text: I have that now. Please, make me a wig.

steps.player: I have that now. Please, make me a wig.

steps.speaker: Ned
steps.text: Okay, I will have a go.
Ned gives you a pretty good wig.

steps.speaker: Ned
steps.text: Here you go. How's that for a quick effort? Not bad I think!

steps.player: Thanks Ned. There's more to you than meets the eye.

options.text: I will come back when I need you to make me one.

steps.player: I will come back when I need you to make me one.

steps.speaker: Ned
steps.text: Well, it sounds like a challenge. Come to me if you need one.

options.text: Could you repair the arrow holes in the back of my shirt?

steps.player: Could you repair the arrow holes in the back of my shirt?

steps.speaker: Ned
steps.text: Ah yes, it's a tough world these days. There's a few brave enough to attack from ten metres away.
Ned pulls out a needle and attacks your shirt.

steps.speaker: Ned
steps.text: There you go, good as new.

steps.player: Thanks Ned. Maybe next time they will attack me face to face.

options.text: Actually, I don't need anything.

steps.player: Actually, I don't need anything.

options.text: Yes, I would like some rope.
No thanks, Ned. I don't need any.

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-aggie.speaker: Aggie
preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-aggie.text: What can I help you with?

options.text: What could you make for me?
Could you think of a way to make skin paste?

steps.player: Could you think of a way to make skin paste?

steps.text: If the player does not have all the required items:

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Why, it's one of my most popular potions. The women here, they like to have smooth looking skin. And I must admit, some of the men buy it as well.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: I can make it for you, just get me what's needed.

steps.player: What do you need to make it?

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Well dearie, you need a base for the paste. That's a mix of ash, flour and water. Then you need redberries to colour it as you want. Bring me those four items and I will make you some.
If the player has all the required items:

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Yes I can, I see you already have the ingredients. Would you like me to mix some for you now?

options.text: Yes please. Mix me some skin paste.

steps.player: Yes please. Mix me some skin paste.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: That should be simple. Hand the things to Aggie then.
You hand the ash, flour, water and redberries to Aggie. Aggie tips the ingredients into a cauldron and mutters some words.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Tourniquet, Fenderbaum, Tottenham, Marshmallow, MarbleArch.
Aggie hands you the Skin Paste.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: There you go dearie, your skin potion. That will make you look good at the Varrock dances.

options.text: No thank you, I don't need any skin paste right now.

steps.player: No thank you, I don't need any skin paste right now.

steps.speaker: Aggie
steps.text: Okay dearie, that's always your choice.

options.text: Cool, do you turn people into frogs?
You mad old witch, you can't help me.
Can you make dyes for me please?

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-lady-.player: Are you the famous Lady Keli? Leader of the toughest gang of mercenary killers around?

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Keli
preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-lady-.text: I am Keli, you have heard of me then?

options.text: Heard of you? You are famous in Gielinor!

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: That's very kind of you to say. Reputations are not easily earned. I have managed to succeed where many fail.

options.text: I have heard a little, but I think Katrine is tougher.

steps.player: I think Katrine is still tougher.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: Well you can think that all you like. I know those blackarm cowards dare not leave the city. Out here, I am toughest. You can tell them that! Now get out of my sight, before I call my guards.

options.text: I have heard rumours that you kill people.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: There's always someone ready to spread rumours. I hear all sort of ridiculous things these days.

options.text: I think Katrine is still tougher.
What is your latest plan then?

steps.player: Of course, you need not go into specific details.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: Well, I can tell you I have a valuable prisoner here in my cells. I can expect a high reward to be paid very soon for this guy. I can't tell you who he is, but he is a lot colder now.

options.text: Ah, I see. You must have been very skillful.

steps.player: You must have been very skillful.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: Yes, I did most of the work. We had to grab the Pr...

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: Er, we had to grab him without his ten bodyguards noticing. It was a stroke of genius.

options.text: Are you sure they will pay?
Can you be sure they will not try to get him out?
I should not disturb someone as tough as you.
That's great, are you sure they will pay?

steps.player: Are you sure they will pay?

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: They will pay, or we will cut his hair off and send it to them.

steps.player: How about trying something tougher? Maybe cut his finger off?

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: That's a good idea, I could use talented people like you. I may call on you if I need work doing.

options.text: You must have been very skillful.
Can you be sure they will not try to get him out?
I should not disturb someone as tough as you.
Can you be sure they will not try to get him out?

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: There is no way to release him. The only key to the door is on a chain around my neck and the locksmith who made the lock died suddenly when he had finished.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: There is not another key like this in the world.

options.text: Could I see the key please?

steps.player: Could I see the key please? Just for a moment. It would be something I can tell my grandchildren. When you are even more famous than you are now.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: As you put it that way I am sure you can see it. You cannot steal the key, it is on a Runite chain.
Keli shows you a small key on a strong looking chain.

options.text: Could I touch the key for a moment please?

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: Only for a moment then.
You put a piece of your soft clay in your hand. As you touch the key, you take an imprint of it.

steps.player: Thank you so much, you are too kind, o great Keli.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: You are welcome, run along now, I am very busy.

options.text: I should not disturb someone as tough as you.
That is a good way to keep secrets.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: It is the best way I know. Dead men tell no tales.

steps.player: I am glad I know none of your secrets, Keli.

options.text: I should not disturb someone as tough as you.
I should not disturb someone as tough as you.
You must have trained a lot for this work.
I should not disturb someone as tough as you.
No I have never really heard of you.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: You must be new to this land then. EVERYONE knows of Lady Keli and her prowess with the sword.

options.text: You must have trained a lot for this work.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: I have used a sword since I was a small girl. I stabbed three people before I was 6 years old.

options.text: I should not disturb someone as tough as you, great lady.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: I need to do a lot of work, goodbye. When you get a little tougher, maybe I will give you a job.

options.text: No, still doesn't ring a bell.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: Well, you know of me now. I will wring your neck if you do not show respect.

options.text: I do not show respect to killers and hoodlums.

steps.player: I do not show respect to killers and hoodlums.

steps.speaker: Lady Keli
steps.text: You should, you really should. I am wealthy enough to place a bounty on your head. Or just remove your head myself. Now go, I am busy, too busy to fight a would-be hoodlum.

options.text: You must have trained a lot for this work.
I should not disturb someone as tough as you, great lady.

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-joe.speaker: Joe
preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-joe.text: Hi, I'm Joe, door guard for Lady Keli.

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-joe.player: Hi, who are you guarding here?

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-joe.speaker: Joe
preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-joe.text: Can't say, all very secret. You should get out of here. I am not supposed to talk while I guard.

preparations-for-rescue-bringing-the-imp.speaker: Osman
preparations-for-rescue-bringing-the-imp.text: Well done; we can make the key now.
Osman takes the key imprint and the bronze bar.

preparations-for-rescue-bringing-the-imp.speaker: Osman
preparations-for-rescue-bringing-the-imp.text: Pick the key up from Leela.

preparations-for-rescue-bringing-the-imp.player: Thank you. I will try to find the other items.
I'm afraid I lost that key you gave me.

preparations-for-rescue-bringing-the-imp.speaker: Osman
preparations-for-rescue-bringing-the-imp.text: Foolish [man/woman]! A new key will cost 15gp.

steps.player: Here, I have 15gp

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: That is good. I will have another key made. You may collect it from Leela.

preparations-for-rescue-bringing-the-imp.text: If the player does not have 15 coins:

steps.player: I haven't got 15 coins with me.

steps.speaker: Osman
steps.text: Then come back to me when you do.

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-leela.speaker: Leela
preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-leela.text: My father sent this key for you. Be careful not to lose it.
Leela gives you a copy of the key to the prince's door.

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-leela.speaker: Leela
preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-leela.text: Good, you have all the basic equipment. Next to deal with the guard on the door. He is talkative, try to find a weakness in him.

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-leela.player: I'm afraid I lost that key you gave me.

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-leela.speaker: Leela
preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-leela.text: Foolish [man/woman]! A new key will cost 15 coins.
If the player does not have 15 coins:

steps.player: I haven't got 15 coins with me.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Then come back to me when you do.

preparations-for-rescue-talking-to-leela.text: If the player does has 15 coins:

steps.text: Leela gives you another key.

options.text: I have some beer here. Fancy one?

steps.player: I have some beer here, fancy one?

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: Ah, that would be lovely, just one now, just to wet my throat.

steps.player: Of course, it must be tough being here without a drink.

steps.text: You hand a beer to the guard, he drinks it in seconds.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: That was perfect, I can't thank you enough.

steps.player: How are you? Still ok? Not too drunk?

steps.text: If the player has less than three beers:

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: No, I don't get drunk with only one drink. You would need a few to do that. But thanks for the beer.
If the player has two more beers:

steps.player: Would you care for another beer, my friend?

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: I better not, I don't want to be drunk on duty.

steps.player: Here, just keep these for later, I hate to see a thirsty guard.

steps.text: You hand two more beers to the guard. He takes a sip of one, and then he drinks them both.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: Franksh, that wash just what I need to shtay on guard. No more beersh, I don't want to get drunk.
The guard is drunk, and no longer a problem.

options.text: Tell me about the life of a guard.

steps.player: Tell me about the life of a guard.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: Well, the hours are good.....

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: .... But most of those hours are a drag. If only I had spent more time in Knight school when I was a young boy. Maybe I wouldn't be here now, scared of Keli.

options.text: Hey, chill out, I won't cause you trouble.

steps.player: Hey, chill out, I won't cause you trouble. I was just wondering what you do to relax.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: You never relax with these people, but it's a good career for a young man and some of the shouting I rather like.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: RESISTANCE IS USELESS!

options.text: So what do you buy with these great wages?

steps.player: So what do you buy with these great wages?

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: Really, after working here, there's only time for a drink or three. All us guards go to the same bar and drink ourselves stupid.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: It's what I enjoy these days, that fade into unconciousness. I can't resist the sight of a really cold beer.
(Shows initial options without the option to offer beer)

options.text: Tell me about the life of a guard.
Would you be interested in making a little more money?
I had better leave, I don't want trouble.
What did you want to be when you were a boy?
I had better leave, I don't want trouble.
What did you want to be when you were a boy?

steps.player: What did you want to be when you were a boy?

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: Well, I loved to sit by the lake, with my toes in the water and shoot the fish with my bow and arrow.

steps.player: That was a strange hobby for a little boy.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: It kept us from goblin hunting, which was what most boys did. What are you here for?

options.text: Chill out, I won't cause you trouble.

steps.player: Hey, chill out, I won't cause you trouble. I was just wondering what you do to relax.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: You never relax with these people, but it's a good career for a young man and some of the shouting I rather like.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: RESISTANCE IS USELESS!

options.text: So what do you buy with these great wages?
Tell me about the life of a guard.
Would you be interested in making a little more money?

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: WHAT?! Are you trying to bribe me? I may not be a great guard, but I am loyal. How DARE you try to bribe me!

steps.player: No, no, you got the wrong idea, totally. I just wondered if you wanted some part-time bodyguard work.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: Oh. Sorry. No, I don't need money. As long as you were not offering me a bribe.
(Shows initial options without the option to offer beer)

options.text: I had better leave, I don't want trouble.
Tell me about the life of a guard.
I had better leave, I don't want trouble.
I had better leave, I don't want trouble.

steps.player: I had better leave, I don't want trouble.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: Thanks, I appreciate that. Talking on duty can be punishable by having your mouth stitched up. These are tough people, no mistake.

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-joe-talk.player: Hello friend, I am just rescuing the prince, is that ok?

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-joe-talk.speaker: Joe
executing-the-rescue-talking-to-joe-talk.text: Thatsh a funny joke. You are lucky I am shober. Go in peace, friend.

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-leela-ag.speaker: Leela
executing-the-rescue-talking-to-leela-ag.text: Ok now, you have all the basic equipment. What are your plans to stop the guard interfering?

options.text: I haven't spoken to him yet.

steps.player: I haven't spoken to him yet.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Well, speaking to him may find a weakness he has. See if there's something that could stop him bothering us.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Good luck with the guard. When the guard is out you can tie up Keli.

options.text: I was going to attack him.

steps.player: I was going to attack him.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: I don't think you should. If you do the rest of the gang and Keli would attack you. The door guard should be removed first, to make it easy.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Good luck with the guard. When the guard is out you can tie up Keli.

options.text: I hoped to get him drunk.

steps.player: I hoped to get him drunk.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Well, that's possible. These guards do like a drink. I would think it will take at least 3 beers to do it well. You would probably have to do it all at the same time too. The effects of the local beer wear off quickly.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Good luck with the guard. When the guard is out you can tie up Keli.

options.text: Maybe I could bribe him to leave.

steps.player: Maybe I could bribe him to leave.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: You could try. I don't think the emir will pay anything towards it. And we did bribe one of their guards once.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Keli killed him in front of the other guards, as a deterrent. It would probably take a lot of gold.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: Good luck with the guard. When the guard is out you can tie up Keli.

options.text: I'm not sure yet.

steps.player: I'm not sure yet.

steps.speaker: Leela
steps.text: You should try talking to him. He might give away some sort of weakness.

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-leela-on.speaker: Leela
executing-the-rescue-talking-to-leela-on.text: You're back. How are things going with that guard?

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-leela-on.speaker: Leela
executing-the-rescue-talking-to-leela-on.text: Great! I think that means we're ready. Go in and use some rope to tie Keli up. Once she's dealt with, use the key to free the Prince. Don't forget to give him his disguise so the guards outside don't spot him.

executing-the-rescue-dealing-with-lady-k.text: If the player is not ready:

steps.text: You cannot tie Keli up until you have all equipment and disabled the guard!
You'd better get rid of Lady Keli before trying to go through there.

executing-the-rescue-dealing-with-lady-k.text: If the player used rope on Lady Keli:

steps.text: You overpower Keli again, tie her up and put her in a cupboard.You must open the door to rescue the prince before she escapes.

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-prince-a.player: Prince, I come to rescue you.

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-prince-a.speaker: Prince Ali
executing-the-rescue-talking-to-prince-a.text: That is very very kind of you, how do I get out?

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-prince-a.player: With a disguise. I have removed the Lady Keli. She is tied up, but will not stay tied up for long.

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-prince-a.text: If the player does not have a complete disguise and key:
If the player has a complete disguise and key:

steps.player: Take this disguise, and this key.

steps.text: You hand over the disguise and key over to Prince Ali.

steps.speaker: Prince Ali
steps.text: Thank you my friend, I must leave you now. My father will pay you well for this.

steps.player: Go to Leela, she is close to here.

steps.text: The prince has escaped, well done! You are now a friend of Al-Kharid and may pass through the Al-Kharid toll gate for free.

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-prince-a.speaker: Prince Ali
executing-the-rescue-talking-to-prince-a.text: I owe you my life for that escape. You cannot help me this time, they know who you are. Go in peace, friend of Al-Kharid.

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-lady-kel.speaker: Lady Keli
executing-the-rescue-talking-to-lady-kel.text: You tricked me, and tied me up, Guards kill this stranger!!

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-joe-afte.speaker: Joe
executing-the-rescue-talking-to-joe-afte.text: Halt! Who goes there? Friend or foe?

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-joe-afte.player: Hi friend, I am just checking out things here.

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-joe-afte.speaker: Joe
executing-the-rescue-talking-to-joe-afte.text: The Prince got away, I am in trouble. I better not talk to you, they are not sure I was drunk.

executing-the-rescue-talking-to-joe-afte.player: I won't say anything, your secret is safe with me.

prince-ali-rescued-talking-to-leela.speaker: Leela
prince-ali-rescued-talking-to-leela.text: Thank you, Al-Kharid will forever owe you for your help. I think that if there is ever anything that needs to be done, you will be someone they can rely on.

prince-ali-rescued-talking-to-osman.speaker: Osman
prince-ali-rescued-talking-to-osman.text: The prince is safe and on his way home with Leela. You can pick up your payment from the chancellor.

prince-ali-rescued-talking-to-chancellor.speaker: Hassan
prince-ali-rescued-talking-to-chancellor.text: You have the eternal gratitude of the Emir for rescuing his son. I am authorised to pay you 700 coins.
